svg.data-power-without-attachments: 44 W (product page, without attachments; brochure, without PoE devices connected)
svg.data-power-input: 100 - 240 V AC, one input, built-in 500 W supply
svg.data-power-poe-note: 450 W guaranteed (3 x 150 W per eight ports); up to 30 W per port at high voltage, 26 W at low
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: brochure: the four SFP+ ports give up to 10 Gbps over optical fibre or Ethernet modules, none included
